button.name: R_volumetric
button.label: Reset group
button.tool_tip: Reset every setting in this section to its default. The per-tier puff counts live on the LOD tab and are not touched

check_box.name: volumetric_check
check_box.label: Draw the volumetric cloud field
check_box.tool_tip: Off leaves the sky to the dome alone - no puffs and no under deck, and so nothing for lightning to hide behind or for precipitation to fall out of

check_box.name: procedural_noise_check
check_box.label: Grow a noise map when the sky authors none
check_box.tool_tip: Holes, towers and the anvil carving still happen on a plain sky: the map is grown from the weather seed, so every client sharing the environment gets the same geography without anyone uploading a texture. Off leaves an unauthored deck evenly covered

check_box.name: tessellation_check
check_box.label: Refine the field near the viewer
check_box.tool_tip: Within a kilometre, each cloud puff grows smaller child puffs around its own body, and the nearest grow a smaller generation still - the field sampling itself finer where it can be seen, a LOD run in puffs rather than vertices. The detail is anchored to each cloud's own frame, so it rides the wind instead of re-rolling, and it fades with distance so it gathers and thins incrementally. The original puffs are untouched; a full puff budget pays for the detail out of the field's far edge

check_box.name: cloud_season_check
check_box.label: Seasonal deck altitude
check_box.tool_tip: Temperature drives an auto-derived deck's base: winter air is dense and squashes the atmosphere down (near 400m at -15C), summer heat lifts it (1.2km at +35C), with the deck capped at a kilometre of thickness. Off keeps the old moisture/convection base derivation

check_box.name: cirrus_season_check
check_box.label: Seasonal cirrus altitude
check_box.tool_tip: Temperature slides the cirrus layer around the authored dome height: low in winter air (about 5km at -15C), lifted by summer heat (about 8km at +35C). Off keeps the authored height exactly

text.name: T_SSAtmoCloudGroundShadow
text.tool_tip: How strongly the deck shadows the ground's direct sunlight, 0 (off) to 1 (full). At full the shade is carried by the weather itself - a thin sheet barely dims, a kilometre-deep storm column goes near-black - so this exists to take the effect away, not to tune it. Shadows slide with the wind drift, lengthen with a low sun, and fade out below roughly ten degrees of elevation

slider_bar.name: SB_SSAtmoCloudGroundShadow
slider_bar.tool_tip: How strongly the deck shadows the ground's direct sunlight. The shade itself is carried by the deck's thickness; 0 turns it off

spinner.name: S_SSAtmoCloudGroundShadow
spinner.tool_tip: How strongly the deck shadows the ground's direct sunlight. The shade itself is carried by the deck's thickness; 0 turns it off
